## Summary

Explain the user-visible improvement and why it belongs in PyWorldAtlas.

## Validation

- [ ] `python maintain.py test`
- [ ] `python maintain.py docs`
- [ ] `python maintain.py check` when preparing a merge-ready change

## Data and documentation

- [ ] Public behavior has tests and clear docstrings.
- [ ] Examples and documentation match the implementation.
- [ ] New or changed facts include source, license, locator, and coverage review.
- [ ] Missing values and interpretation limits remain explicit.
- [ ] The change contains no secrets, private information, or unrelated files.

If an item does not apply, explain why in the summary.
